description: This Java class 'ModelTestSuite' is used to bootstrap and manage a JUnit test suite for the OFBiz framework, dynamically loading and preparing various test cases including class-based, service, simple method, WebDriver, and XML assertion tests.

classes.name: ModelTestSuite
classes.description: Main class for setting up and executing a dynamic JUnit test suite within the OFBiz testing framework, capable of loading various test types and configuring test environment.

methods.name: ModelTestSuite
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the test suite by parsing XML elements and loading test cases accordingly.

methods.name: parseTestElement
methods.description: Parses individual test elements from XML and adds corresponding test instances to the test list.

methods.name: getSuiteName
methods.description: Returns the name of the test suite.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Returns the Delegator instance used in the test suite.

methods.name: getTestList
methods.description: Returns the list of test instances.

methods.name: makeTestSuite
methods.description: Creates and returns a JUnit TestSuite containing all configured tests.

methods.name: prepareTest
methods.description: Prepares individual tests by setting delegator, dispatcher, and other context-specific configurations.

methods.name: prepareGroovyScriptAssert
methods.description: Sets delegator, dispatcher, and security context for Groovy script assertion tests.
